name: lofi-night-window-figure
prompt: Vertical portrait still of a small, cosy attic bedroom late at night, seen from just inside the doorway so the whole nook reads at once. Perched sideways on a deep, cushioned window ledge, knees drawn up and back slumped easily against the frame, sits a lone figure in a soft charcoal knitted balaclava that covers the entire head with no openings at all: no eye holes, no nose hole, no mouth hole, no skin anywhere. A thick white ring is stitched in yarn around the whole front of the face, and one small red triangle with softened, rounded corners, point facing down, is sewn high up inside that ring on the right-hand side of the picture. The figure wears an oversized cream knit jumper, loose joggers, thick woolly socks and dark knitted gloves, chunky over-ear headphones resting on the mask, and cradles a wide ceramic mug with both gloved hands, a thin curl of steam drifting up past the white ring. Body angled three-quarters toward the camera, head tilted a few degrees toward the glass, shoulders dropped, utterly unbothered. Beyond the tall window, beaded rain and long trickling streaks blur a sprawling city of rooftops and towers glowing in candyfloss pink, soft violet and cobalt blue, with a few hazy lit windows and a distant water tower in silhouette. Inside, a low desk to the left holds an angled lamp throwing a pool of honey-amber light, a leaning tower of worn paperbacks, a trailing pothos spilling over its pot, an old cassette player and a tangle of warm-white string lights pinned along the sloped ceiling. Hand-painted animated illustration with gentle grain, flat soft shading and visible brushy texture, low contrast, warm amber inside meeting cool neon outside along the window edge, faint bloom on every light source, quiet and still, the hush before anyone speaks. Medium-wide framing at seated eye level, slight lens softness at the corners. No text, no lettering, no logos, no signs, no animals. Thanks.
